e.title: Agentic BOP Underwriting (UConn)
e.summary: arXiv 论文《Agentic AI and RAG in Straight-Through Underwriting》官方配套：635 份合成 BOP 数据集 + 三种承保流水线参考实现
e.body: agentic-bop-underwriting 是 arXiv:2607.07858《Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Models in Straight-Through Underwriting》（Richardson, Meyers, Hartman, Sandberg——含 UConn 精算教授 Brian Hartman）的官方配套仓库：包含 635 份合成商业业主保单（BOP）数据集、论文对比的三种承保流水线实现（single-LLM、naive RAG、multi-agent Agentic RAG）、预计算评估结果与复现笔记本，另有 143 页合成核保指南书（guidebook）与结构化指引。对 RIAA：直通式核保（STP）agentic RAG 的可复现基准——做核保 AI 评测的现成数据集与基线。关联 [[aws-insurance-underwriting-genai]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[snorkel-multiturn-underwriting]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]、[[actuarial-skills]]。

e.summary_en: Official companion repo of the arXiv paper 'Agentic AI and RAG in Straight-Through Underwriting': 635-application synthetic BOP dataset + three underwriting pipeline implementations
e.summary_hk: arXiv 論文《Agentic AI and RAG in Straight-Through Underwriting》官方配套：635 份合成 BOP 數據集 + 三種承保流水線參考實現
e.body_en: agentic-bop-underwriting is the official companion repo of arXiv:2607.07858 'Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Models in Straight-Through Underwriting' (Richardson, Meyers, Hartman, Sandberg — including UConn actuarial professor Brian Hartman): it ships a 635-application synthetic Business Owner Policy (BOP) dataset, implementations of the three underwriting pipelines compared in the paper (single-LLM, naïve RAG, multi-agent Agentic RAG), precomputed evaluation results and a reproduction notebook, plus a 143-page synthetic underwriting guidebook and structured guidelines. For RIAA: a reproducible benchmark for straight-through (STP) agentic-RAG underwriting — a ready-made dataset and baselines for underwriting-AI evaluation. Related: [[aws-insurance-underwriting-genai]], [[underwriting-intel-mcp]], [[snorkel-multiturn-underwriting]], [[claimpilot-harness]], [[actuarial-skills]].
e.body_hk: agentic-bop-underwriting 是 arXiv:2607.07858《Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Models in Straight-Through Underwriting》（Richardson, Meyers, Hartman, Sandberg——含 UConn 精算教授 Brian Hartman）的官方配套倉庫：包含 635 份合成商業業主保單（BOP）數據集、論文對比的三種承保流水線實現（single-LLM、naive RAG、multi-agent Agentic RAG）、預計算評估結果與複現筆記本，另有 143 頁合成核保指南書（guidebook）與結構化指引。對 RIAA：直通式核保（STP）agentic RAG 的可複現基準——做核保 AI 評測的現成數據集與基線。關聯 [[aws-insurance-underwriting-genai]]、[[underwriting-intel-mcp]]、[[snorkel-multiturn-underwriting]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]、[[actuarial-skills]]。
